title: Biggest Player of Indian Toy Industry | Urban Tots Case Study - Ashutosh Pratihast
description:
Join me, Ashutosh Pratihast, as we dive into the inspiring journey of Urban Tots, a Bhiwani-based toy company that turned a pandemic challenge into a success story. Founded by Deepak Chaudhary, who transitioned from household crockery to toys during the Covid crisis, Urban Tots quickly became a multi-million dollar powerhouse in the Indian toy industry.
